title: Unified inbox
caption: Chats from WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Instagram, Discord, LINE and Beeper in one list, with a group conversation showing a photo, reactions, a reply and a voice note.

title: Filter by network
caption: The networks filter lists every connected network with its unread count.

title: Writing help settings
caption: Per-chat writing help: default language, how you address this person, the quick button and the quick action on messages.

title: Writing help menu
caption: The writing help menu offers spelling, grammar and phrasing fixes or a translation of the draft.

title: Draft corrected
caption: A draft fixed for spelling and grammar, with the original kept below the field and an Undo button.

title: Translate received messages
caption: One tap translates a received message; the translation appears under the original.

title: Voice note transcription
caption: A voice message transcribed on demand, the text shown right under the player.

title: Agent in a chat
caption: Attach an agent to a chat: choose which one, when it answers and whether its replies wait for your review.

title: Agent draft
caption: Asked for a packing list, the chat's agent writes a draft you can send, edit or drop.

title: Settings: Agents (LLM)
caption: Create agents from your own language models: a name, a description and instructions, no tools and no memory.

title: Settings: General
caption: General settings: language, notifications, session and passkey sign-in.

title: Settings: Extensions
caption: Every extension of the server, what it connects to and what it reads, each one switchable.

title: Join a Matrix room
caption: New conversation on the Beeper account, with the field to join a Matrix room by its address.

title: Discreet reading
caption: Read messages without sending read receipts, per account or per conversation.

title: Quiet hours
caption: Quiet hours hold back chats and notifications per network until the hours end.

title: Chat list on a phone
caption: The inbox on a phone, installable as a web app.

title: Conversation on a phone
caption: A group conversation on a phone, with the agent's draft waiting above the message field.

title: New chat on a phone
caption: Start a conversation on any account, or join a Matrix room, from a phone.

title: Writing help on a phone
caption: Per-chat writing help settings and message translations on a phone.

title: Dark theme
caption: The inbox and a group conversation in the dark theme.

title: Writing help in dark theme
caption: A draft corrected by the writing help, in the dark theme.

title: Translation in dark theme
caption: Received messages translated under the originals, in the dark theme.
